name: Oathbow
description: A tall elven longbow strung with silver, that whispers when drawn.
body:
## What it does

When you nock an arrow it whispers in Elvish for the swift defeat of your enemies.

## Sworn enemy

When you make a ranged attack with it, you can swear its target your sworn enemy until it dies or seven dawns pass. You can have one at a time, and after one dies you can swear another at the next dawn. Against it you have advantage, it gains nothing from cover short of total, long range costs you nothing, and every hit deals more piercing damage. While it lives, you have disadvantage with every other weapon.
